title: Creative Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities Design compelling brand banners, social media creatives, digital advertisements, brochures, and marketing collateral. Create and edit high-quality videos for marketing campaigns, social media, events, and corporate communications. Produce motion graphics, animations, and visual storytelling content. Utilize AI tools to generate concepts, images, videos, and creative variations while maintaining brand consistency. Collaborate with marketing and content teams to execute campaigns that strengthen brand visibility and engagement. Ensure all creative assets align with brand guidelines and business objectives 
 Required Skills (Must Have) Strong proficiency in: Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Microsoft PowerPoint Optional Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects Canva and/or Figma AI expertise is mandatory , including hands-on experience with: Adobe Firefly Microsoft Copilot ChatGPT/Claude Optional Midjourney Runway ML Kling AI Canva AI Leonardo AI or equivalent AI creative platforms 
 Language Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to understand creative briefs and present ideas effectively. 
 Experience & Qualifications 1-3 years of experience in Graphic Design, Multimedia Design, or Visual Communication. Strong portfolio showcasing brand banners, marketing creatives, and AI-generated creative work. Good understanding of branding, typography, colour theory, and visual storytelling. 

 Preferred candidate profile

Key Skills: Ai Techniques,Indesign,PowerPoint,Illustrator,Photoshop,Firefly,Copilot,Aftereffects
